summary: 40-foot steel tower at the Bonners Ferry Ranger Station, Kaniksu NF, built in the 1930s and gone by 1960; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 40-foot steel tower at the ranger station
facts.status_note: Gone by 1960; Idaho Fire Lookouts labels it removed, the Forest Fire Lookout Association marks it gone; no source describes a standing tower

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site drive-up; no source describes what remains at the ranger station or whether the grounds are open to visitors

events.note: Sources give the 1930s only; the year 1930 here stands for the decade
Both history pages give 1960 as the year the tower was gone; Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site removed

corrections.why: Both history pages give 1960 as the year the tower was gone, and Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site 'Drive-Up Removed'; neither describes it as abandoned

evidence.supports: 1930s construction of a 40-foot steel tower at the ranger station
site listed as drive-up and removed
location about a mile southwest of Bonners Ferry
Kaniksu National Forest as the forest

evidence.quote: Bonners Ferry Ranger Station Boundary 48.67327 -116.33885 Tower Gone

evidence.supports: Kaniksu National Forest for the ranger station entry

sources.title: Bonners Ferry R.S. Fire Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Correction: brief event '1960 abandoned' proposed as 'removed'; sources say 'Gone 1960' and 'Drive-Up Removed', and none says abandoned. The 1930s build date is a decade only, from two history pages; no single year is documented. No staffing or fire history on any page; the Idaho page says it has no documented staffing history, so no staffing facts are recorded. The Forest Lookouts index gives the station a Kaniksu NF township (61N-1E-4) and no history. No firetower.org record for this station turned up in the cache or the search. 40 ft converted to 12.2 m; the source gives the tower as '40' steel tower' without saying whether this is pole or total height. Today: no source describes the site now; access level not recorded. Idaho page dated September 16, 2025.
